source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Change all/random setting to non-default in this BIOS function.
3. Save and reboot.
4. Boot in to BIOS and  check your setting still exist.
5. Press load default,save and reboot.
6. Boot in to BIOS,setting in this function should match the SPEC.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. No error log happen.
2. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
3. Check your setting still exist.
4. The default setting should matches SPEC."

original_test_intent: Verify that approved BMC account, role or authentication-policy values configured through BIOS persist and return to SPEC defaults without weakening privilege boundaries, disclosing credentials, locking out all administrators or losing OOB recovery.
original_method: Using a disposable approved account and independent administrator, manually change named BMC User Settings fields, save/reboot and verify persistence/access, then Load Default, save/reboot, compare with SPEC and restore the final access policy.
manual_activity: A trusted engineer must operate the firmware account UI, enter credentials outside captured evidence, interpret role/privilege fields, complete save/default phases and validate recovery access. Agent authentication checks cannot replace these actions.
required_inputs: BIOS/BMC identity and account-store synchronization behavior
Named disposable account and approved role/channel privileges
Password/lockout/authentication-source policy without exposing secret values
SPEC defaults stated as non-secret properties
Independent break-glass administrator and local/serial console
Credential rotation and final approved policy
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random for users, roles, passwords, authentication sources or lockout policy.
Do not record plaintext credentials, tokens, hashes, recovery codes or secret screenshots in logs/evidence.
Never modify the final independent administrator or sole recovery account.
Use bounded failed-login checks only if explicitly approved; stop before lockout thresholds.
Stop on privilege escalation, unexpected account creation/deletion, lockout or audit failure.
agent_execution_scope: Collect redacted non-secret user identifiers, enabled state, roles/channel privileges, audit events, BMC reachability and host health.
Perform only approved authentication outcome checks with credentials supplied securely and never echoed or stored.
Do not drive BIOS, create/delete users, change credentials/roles or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve account/role/default matrix, secret handling, lockout bounds and break-glass recovery.
Perform/capture the firmware lifecycle with secrets redacted and restore/rotate credentials.
Evaluate authorization and audit evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly refuses BIOS execution. No source command exists; BMC API account writes would exercise a different management path and risk secret exposure.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the firmware path; add only approved redacted read-only user/privilege metadata and audit checks. Never substitute generic account-creation commands.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source lifecycle, null script and 5/20-minute fields are retained; all/random is preserved only as unsafe original wording.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Test one approved disposable account at a time, map effective role/channel privileges and lockout policy, keep a separate break-glass administrator, and collect redacted authentication/audit evidence through persistence/defaults and rotation.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BIOS/BMC account store, firmware revision and enabled authentication sources.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS, BMC, management protocol/client and audit-log schema versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform BMC user/role/channel and recovery documentation plus project credential policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces arbitrary access-control changes with least-privilege, redacted and recoverable account testing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; preserves lifecycle while adding effective authorization, audit and secret-handling coverage.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Account/role matrix, defaults, lockout rules and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Displayed role names may not equal effective per-channel privileges; acceptance must check the approved access surface.

project_override_considerations: The project may approve one disposable role and exclude password-policy or external-directory fields. Results must identify tested accounts/channels and cannot claim untested privilege or authentication-source coverage.
expected_evidence: Platform/account-store identity, redacted role/default matrix, approval and recovery
Baseline non-secret account/privilege state and break-glass validation
Non-default firmware captures with secrets redacted, persistence and approved access/audit results
Load Default, SPEC comparison and safe access behavior
Final policy, credential rotation confirmation, audits and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The persistence/default lifecycle is coherent for actual BMC user-policy fields. Missing credentials, roles and defaults are protected project inputs rather than contradictory source facts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The account-policy intent is clear. Secure credentials, a disposable account and independent recovery are execution gates, not an intrinsic semantic block.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees with manual operation and adds account security/recovery controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its non-secret evidence, lab account and lockout safeguards while correcting classification to MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates core human security configuration from agent evidence and forbids secret capture and last-admin mutation.

review_improvement: Adds effective privilege, audit and credential-rotation validation instead of treating sensitive BMC account controls as generic settings.
independent_technical_reasoning: The decisive firmware edits, secret entry and access-policy interpretation require a trusted human. Automated redacted checks validate consequences but cannot execute the core test, so MANUAL ONLY is required.
no_automatic_retry: Do not automatically repeat credential, privilege, lockout, save/default or authentication actions after failure; preserve redacted evidence and obtain security-owner disposition.
